title: Single Arm Study of WSD0922-FU for NSCLC Patients with C797S mutation
official: A Phase II, Open Label, Multicenter, Single Arm Study of WSD0922-FU for Patients with Locally Advanced or Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer whose Disease has Progressed with First-Line Osimertinib Treatment and whose Tumors harbor a C797S mutation within the Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor Gene
summary: Main objective: To determine the recommended phase 2 dose [RP2D] and to assess the efficacy of WSD0922-FU by assessment of Objective Response Rate (ORR) by Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) v1.1.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 1. Provision of signed and dated, written informed consent prior to any study-specific procedures, sampling and analyses.
2. 10. Females should be using adequate contraceptive measures.
3. 11. Male patients should be willing to use barrier contraception i.e., condoms.
4. 12. Patient must be stable on no more than 2 mg of dexamethasone.
5. 2. Male or female aged ≥18 years old.
6. 3. Histological or cytological confirmation diagnosis of NSCLC.
7. 4. Locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC, not amenable to curative surgery or radiotherapy.
8. 5. Evidence of radiological disease progression.
9. 6. Documented EGFR mutation
10. 7. Patients must have confirmation of C797S mutation positive status.
11. 8.Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) 0-1.
12. 9. At least one lesion, not previously irradiated and not chosen for biopsy during the study.
Exclusion criteria:
1. 1 Treatment with more than 2 prior lines of treatment for advanced NSCLC.Treatment with Osimertinib within 8 days of the first dose of study treatment.
2. 10. History of hypersensitivity of WSD0922-FU.
3. 11. Males and females of reproductive potential who are not using an effective method of birth control.
4. 12. Judgment by the investigator that the patient should not participate in the study if the patient is unlikely to comply with study procedures, restrictions and requirements.
5. 13. Known intracranial hemorrhage which is unrelated to tumor.
6. 14. Seizures requiring a change.
7. 15. Patient must not take enzyme-inducing anticonvulsants treatment.
8. 2. Any unresolved toxicities from prior therapy greater than CTCAE Grade 1.
9. 3. Symptomatic brain complications that require urgent neurosurgical or medical intervention.
10. 4. Leptomeningeal metastasis.
11. 5.Any evidence of severe or uncontrolled systemic diseases.
12. 6.Refractory nausea and vomiting, chronic gastrointestinal diseases, inability to swallow the formulated product or previous significant bowel resection.
13. 7. Any of the following cardiac criteria: Mean resting corrected QT interval (QTc) > 480 msec, obtained from electrocardiograms (ECGs); Any clinically important abnormalities in rhythm; Any factors that increase the risk of QTc prolongation.
14. 8. Past medical history of ILD, drug-induced ILD, radiation pneumonitis which required steroid treatment, or any evidence of clinically active ILD.
15. 9.Inadequate bone marrow reserve or organ function as demonstrated.
